text: About Staycation – Our Story & How We Curate Hotels | Staycation.com Near Me Destinations Near Me Destinations Currency Our Story About Staycation Staycation is a curated guide to boutique and luxury hotels across Asia, Europe, and beyond — built for travellers who care as much about the stay as the destination. What We Do A more considered way to find a hotel Most hotel search starts with a price filter. Ours starts with a point of view. Every property on Staycation is hand-selected by our editors — we look for places with a strong sense of identity, thoughtful design, and genuinely warm hospitality. From a heritage shophouse in Singapore to a cliffside ryokan in Hakone, the goal is the same: a stay worth remembering. Our Criteria What earns a place in the collection Character Independent boutiques, design-led properties, and storied grand hotels with a distinct point of view. No generic chains. Craft Attention to detail in the architecture, the service, and the small touches — from the linens to the breakfast. Place Hotels that belong to where they are. We favour properties that draw on local culture, materials, and landscape. Transparency How Staycation makes money Staycation is free to use. When you find a hotel you love, we hand you off to Agoda to complete your reservation — they handle payment, confirmation, and customer support. If you book through one of our links, Agoda pays us a small commission at no extra cost to you. That's how we keep the lights on, and it's why we're picky about what we recommend: we only earn when you actually want to stay.
